name: If a Tree Falls, and No One Hears...
summary: A trapped lumberjack asks you to fetch help from Turner's Logging Camp. He fears bleeding out or being eaten if he remains trapped.

sections.title: A Call for Help
sections.body: A lumberjack is trapped at the site of an accident. He asks you to go to Turner's Logging Camp and bring help before he bleeds out or wild animals find him.

faq.answer: A lumberjack from the nearby logging camp is trapped after an accident.
He asks you to fetch help from Turner's Logging Camp.
He says he may bleed out or be eaten by wild animals if he stays trapped.

attribution: In-game quest text: If a Tree Falls, and No One Hears...
